title: Add KitKind Enum to Rust Lib
description: Add KitKind Enum to Rust Lib
summary: Added KitKind enum with 5 variants (File, Folder, Archive, Remote, Temporary) serializing to lowercase strings. Added ALL_KIT_KINDS constant. Added 5 tests: completeness, serialization, deserialization, Kit JSON roundtrip, in-memory modification. All tests pass.
